login.label: PASSCODE
login.title: Enter Passcode
login.description: Enter the passcode to start your experience.

errors.missingPasscode: Passcode setting was not found. Please check REACT_APP_PASSCODE.

step1.title: Your Favorite Mood
step1.description: Choose the art style that sets the mood of your vision board.

step2.title: About You
step2.description: Please enter the basic information that will be reflected in your vision board.
step2.hairAppearancePlaceholder: e.g. long black hair, curly hair, tall

step3.title: You and Your Future
step3.description: Tell us who you are now and the future you want to create.
step3.selfExpressionHelper: Write as specifically as possible about what you like, your personality, and the values you care about.
step3.selfExpressionPlaceholder: e.g. I love the outdoors, I am curious, I enjoy making things, I value freedom in how I work
step3.idealVision: The Future You Want to Create
step3.idealVisionPlaceholder: e.g. In one year, I want to work in Tokyo in my own way. In ten years, I want to have an atelier near nature.

step4.title: Add More Depth
step4.description: Optional. Choose the areas you want to reflect more deeply and fill them in.

identity.title: My Core
identity.helper: Fill this in only if you want the result to feel even more like you.
identity.happyMomentPlaceholder: e.g. traveled with friends, started something new

learn.title: Learning
learn.helper: Organize what you want to learn and why you want to learn it.
learn.want: What do you want to learn?
learn.reason: Why do you want to learn it?
learn.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. career growth, hobby, personal growth
learn.whenWhere: When and where do you want to learn?

work.title: Work
work.helper: Clarify your ideal work and working style.
work.style: What kind of work or working style do you want?
work.values: What do you value at work?
work.incomePlace: What is your ideal income or work location?

residence.title: Lifestyle
residence.helper: Organize where and how you want to live.
residence.place: Where do you want to live?
residence.environment: What kind of home or environment do you want?
residence.environmentPlaceholder: e.g. spacious home, close to nature, convenient location

marriage.title: Partnership
marriage.helper: Organize your thoughts about partnership and marriage.
marriage.idealRelation: What is your ideal relationship with a partner?
marriage.thoughts: How do you feel about marriage or living together?
marriage.thoughtsPlaceholder: e.g. I want to get married, I want to consider living together first

child.title: Children / Parenting
child.helper: Organize your thoughts about children and parenting.
child.thoughts: How do you feel about having children?
child.thoughtsPlaceholder: e.g. I want children, not sure yet, no strong preference
child.values: What would you value in parenting?

oldAge.title: Later Life
oldAge.helper: Think about your ideal later life and what you want to prepare now.
oldAge.ideal: What is your ideal senior life?
oldAge.idealPlaceholder: e.g. peaceful life, travel, time with family
oldAge.preparation: What do you want to prepare for later life?

nextAction.title: Next Action
nextAction.helper: Writing one small step you can take this month makes it easier to take action.
nextAction.action: What is one small step you can take this month?
nextAction.actionPlaceholder: e.g. plan a new route, start gathering information

step5.title: Review Your Answers
step5.description: Please review your answers, agree to the terms, and continue to generation.
